turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on always, usually, sometimes and never?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Sure. These words tell us how often:
always = every time
usually = most times
sometimes = some times
never = not at all

They go before the main verb: My brother usually gets up at seven.

Write this sentence again with never in the right place: "I have coffee in the evening."
